What does skateboardsamsterdam.nl tell AI shopping agents?

Yes: UCP profile found skateboardsamsterdam.nl is a Shopify store we track, listed under Shopify stores (mixed, mostly Europe). In ShopBot Index's crawl of 2026-10-26, it publishes a UCP profile, the profile AI shopping agents read, at /.well-known/ucp, declaring 13 capabilities including checkout.

What this means. AI shopping agents that use the Universal Commerce Protocol can read this store's profile to see what it supports, including checkout. It doesn't guarantee that a given assistant buys from it; that depends on the assistant.
